Cecilia Cello is a member of the UFS.


Personality
She has a free-spirited, absentminded and childlike personality. Cecilia is mostly unaware of danger and gets distracted easy. She has the biggest sweet tooth and carries sweets, specially chocolate with her, all the time. Her cooking ability shifts from time to time, sometimes follows the recipe other time, adds random ingredients which ends terribly.

She is a tea party buddy with, Lune and both are close friends.

Appearance
She is blond hair and blue eyes, she has hair bits that look like dog ears.

History
Background
A girl born in a UFS research facility.

Artificially created via gene manipulation, she was born with superhuman abilities to control strong demon powers. Along with her innate powers, she received a strict, special education from the UFS researchers. Not only are her physical powers outstanding, her mental capabilities are also other-worldly. Some of the data collected from her fights was later used for Viera.

During the prototype stages her institute was attacked by a group of demons, under the control of Nomad and many of the researchers which created her died, Cecilia took the prototype weapons and attached them to her body and forced the demons to flee but feel afterward in a coma. Afterward, the weakness of Cecilia became clear that her use of magic consumed many calories, and she required a constant sugar intake.

Timeline TABA
Appears, while Fuuma Kotaro battles Yatsu Murasaki. Cecilia destroys all the traps in the location, which were made for Murasaki, and surprises both sides. Was sent out to capture Murasaki herself and turn her into Assault Murasaki. Cecilia is later "captured" by the Fuuma Organization but seems to be happy with it as long as she is given food. She befriends Lilim and both of them love to snack together.

At some point Renee of the UFS, tries to save Cecilia when Kotaro was captured by Tekkain Kaworu. However, the matter resolved itself and all parties parted as friends. Seen later on, together with Nasara and Yoimachi Akari, buying a number of sweets.

Timeline RPGX
Is less of an enemy and can join the Independent Rangers.


Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Hands

Infuse Magic: Can infuse lifeless objects with magic and control them. She can do this to all machines but requires a constant flood of food to keep the control.
